facts.fact: GPE's Independent Technical Advisory Panel, reporting on 8 April 2024, found no clear evidence that Togo has student identification numbers (or a master list of schools), and said an automatic data collection system was still being developed; it gives no count of schools.

systems.country_label: SIGE (système d'information pour la gestion de l'éducation)
systems.tiers: Official annual data collection for pre-primary, primary, secondary and TVET, published in statistical yearbooks within three months of the school year's end; the panel says Togo does not yet have a fully accessible, operational SIGE because nothing links the quantitative, financial and qualitative data

systems.system: système de collecte automatique des données
systems.tiers: Still being developed, per the country's self-analysis

systems.system: SYNECAT (système national d'évaluation des compétences des apprenants)
systems.tiers: Planned sample learning assessment every two years in CP2 and CM1 and at lower secondary; not an information system schools enter into
